say:1:1035411001:1.text: That's right. This journey has been tiring. We plan to rest here for a bit.
say:1:1035411001:1.source_cn: 是的，毕竟舟车劳顿实在是太累了，我们打算在这里歇歇。

choice_prompt:2:1035411001.text: That's right. This journey has been tiring. We plan to rest here for a bit.

say:3:1035411002:1.text: We have plenty of time to make the journey.
say:3:1035411002:1.source_cn: 从时间上看，我们是完全来的及的。

say:6:1035411004:1.text: What? Hahaha! That's a good one! A well-trained horse would never run away.
say:6:1035411004:1.source_cn: 马跑了？哈哈哈哈你想法还挺有趣嘛，好好的马怎么可能跑了呢？
say:6:1035411004:1.male: What? Hahaha! That's a good one! A well-trained horse would never run away.
say:6:1035411004:1.female: What? Hahaha! That's a good one! A well-trained horse would never run away.

say:7:1035411005:1.text: I bet nothing like that has ever happened in the Mithril Consortium.
say:7:1035411005:1.source_cn: 我敢打赌，绝对不会出现这种状况！

say:8:1035411006:1.text: If it has... that just means their owners were total idiots.
say:8:1035411006:1.source_cn: 如果真有的话……那这驾车的人也太蠢了。

choice:5:0:1.text: What if your horse runs away?
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 万一路上有突发状况呢？比如马跑了？
choice:5:0:1.male: What if your horse runs away?
choice:5:0:1.female: What if your horse runs away?

choice:2:0:1.text: Can you make it in time?
choice:2:0:1.male: Can you make it in time?
choice:2:0:1.female: Can you make it in time?

say:10:1035411007:1.text: You don't need to worry about that. Feldman and I are pretty tough!
say:10:1035411007:1.source_cn: 这个你不用担心，我和菲尔曼的身手可是很厉害的！

say:10:1035411007:1.female: You don't need to worry about that. Feldman and I are pretty tough!

say:11:1035411008:1.source_cn: 我们自保的能力还是很厉害的。

choice:2:1:2.text: Might not be safe to rest here.
